summary: Silicon Motion Technology filed a Form 6-K (its US-equivalent current report on Form 8-K) disclosing an increased annual cash dividend of $2.30 per ADS, a 15% increase over the $2.00 per ADS declared in 2025. The board declared four quarterly installments of $0.575 per ADS, equivalent to $0.14375 per ordinary share, with record dates November 5, 2026, February 16, May 6, and August 5, 2027, and payments roughly two weeks later. No advisor or recommendation disclosed; dividends remain subject to board determination. Watch payout sustainability versus capex and cyclical NAND demand.
